qpr: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: football team player portrait sprite sheet. Create a single wide 2:1 image ideally 2048 x 1024, containing EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND TWO ROWS: eight equal square portrait tiles tessellated edge to edge. No gutters, no margins, no borders. Each tile has its own separate soft neutral slate studio background, a single unique fictional male grassroots football player centered chest-up facing camera, fully visible head with generous headroom and both shoulders visible. Subjects are eight DISTINCT friendly amateur adult men aged 25–50, varied ethnicities, body shapes and hairstyles; realistic natural skin texture, welcoming individual expressions, natural studio portrait photography with consistent soft lighting and matching portrait scale across all tiles. Every man wears the same plain royal blue football jersey with no crest, no logos, no text. Top row left to right: white man around 30 with short curly brown hair; Black man around 35 with close cropped hair and beard; South Asian man around 28 with wavy dark hair and stubble; white man around 48 with receding grey hair and fuller build. Bottom row left to right: East Asian man around 32 with short black hair; mixed race man around 26 with longer curly hair; white man around 40 with red hair and beard; Middle Eastern man around 45 with salt and pepper hair and beard. Eight entirely fictional identities, no real player likenesses. STRICT layout: portraits must individually fit exact quarters of image width and halves of height, as if each is a 512x512 photograph in a 2048x1024 contact sheet. Heads never cross tile boundaries, no extra people, no collage overlap. No text, numbers, names, watermarks, grid lines or decorative elements anywhere.
